entries.10e20862765234f8: The company provides the specialized multi-channel program distribution service "JC-HITS" and others for cable television operators, and also operates channels for cable television operators, produces programs, and distributes them itself. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,696 million.
entries.3aa7bb0f7cb1a5c9: The company leases real estate for data centers, installs power supply facilities and information and communication equipment, and provides internet information services: it houses operators' servers in racks and provides connection to communication lines and operation outsourcing of computer equipment. The main site is the Shin-Otemachi Site in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥4,822 million.
entries.4a536b6bd567968c: The company provides the data broadcasting distribution service "JC-data" for community channels of cable television operators, and a regional disaster prevention DX solution for local governments. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥660 million.
entries.560c86a8026f1983: A business carried out by the consolidated subsidiary Japan Cable Cast Co., Ltd., which provides a content platform for cable television operators and an information platform for cable television operators and local governments. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥3,356 million.
entries.7e71dd831498016f: Companies that introduce cloud services and storage products
entries.8b0ba98e42548704: The consolidated subsidiary TSS Link Co., Ltd. mainly develops and sells information leak prevention software products. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥165 million.
entries.9c187483a66a3662: A business carried out by the company and its consolidated subsidiary TSS Link Co., Ltd., which provides four services: data center, cloud solutions, data solutions and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥11,878 million.
entries.b9e203ead65df7ff: The company provides sales and maintenance services for storage devices and related software products for which it holds agency rights. Its main products are "Dell PowerScale / Isilon" made by Dell Technologies, and it also provides and supports in Japan "Eyeglass," a ransomware countermeasure software developed by Canada's Superna, and "Scality RING" made by Scality. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥4,821 million.
entries.ce88dc8ee146c701: The company provides cloud-related services, including the development and sale of its in-house cloud service "c9," resale of third-party cloud services under sales partnerships, construction, operation and maintenance support, construction of multi-cloud environments, MSP monitoring and operation services, and SaaS-type security solutions. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,048 million.
entries.f0133e2a0317f6ca: A company that provides IT infrastructure services in data centers, cloud and storage, and program distribution and information distribution for cable television operators.
